prerequisites: An entrance test will verify the starting level of knowledge.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of writing and speaking in English, including technical discussions in the field of specialization.
Achieve an English knowledge equivalent to the B1 level.

syllabus_topics: The student's learning path, along with the relevant course content, will be determined based on their initial proficiency level, as assessed by the placement test.
teaching_methods: Exercises on important points and targeted listening exercises
Specific projections on complex issues in the original language

assessment_methods.method: Combined written and oral exam at the University Language Center

assessment_rules: The assessment is a combined written and oral exam, resulting in a final judgment. Further information can be found at https://www.cla.unisa.it/verifiche/index. The Degree Program Board may recognize credits based on previously acquired English Language Knowledge Certification from a Certified Body.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica (Mechanical Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
